comment: A RECORDED run, not a CI gate: mutating the tree and running every layer takes minutes and cannot be part of the per-commit gates. What IS gated is the campaign DEFINITION (every anchor still resolves) and this file's internal consistency — see tests/test_generated_docs.py.

mutations.what: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers
the reference stops declaring a projection on its layers
mutations.rule: engine protocol: every layer declares what its engine could produce

mutations.what: the reference silently drops the foreign engine entries when regenerating
mutations.rule: engine protocol: an engine writes only its own entry, and carries foreign ones through

mutations.what: the reference's verification accepts a partial projection that names no members
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a partial projection must NAME the members it carries

mutations.what: the reference's verification accepts a 'full' projection that also names members
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a full projection emits the whole surface and claims nothing else

mutations.what: the port declares its verdict layer FULL while it is at the checkpoint-4 projection
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a projection that over-claims is exactly what the field exists to prevent

mutations.what: the port drops `column` from its verdict records while still claiming it
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a projection names exactly the members its documents carry

mutations.what: the port stamps a refused layer with the 'produced' status
mutations.rule: artifact: status is produced or refused, and a refusal carries no document

mutations.what: the port claims a surface version for the MOS dump, which has none
mutations.rule: artifact: surface_version is null when the surface has none — absence is data

mutations.what: the port reports a typed-door refusal on one layer instead of all three
mutations.rule: artifact: every engine reports exactly the frozen layers, in that order

mutations.what: the port's verification stops rejecting a 'full' projection that names members
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a full projection emits the whole surface and claims nothing else

mutations.what: the port's verification accepts an EMPTY reason on a partial projection
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a partial projection must say WHY the remaining members are absent
